node.title: PMA sigma-one source-pinned low-defect payment
node.statement: On every official sigma=1 maximal sunflower, summing the pinned interpolation-owner bounds over all defect sets D, both exact background states, and d<=2 gives B_low=(k-1)[M+floor(C(n-k,2)/3)]+C(k-1,2)[floor(C(n-k,2)/3)+floor(C(n-k,3)/4)]<n^5/1024. This field-independent per-sunflower theorem replaces the failed ambient B11 q^4 certificate and leaves GROW={d>=3}; the later first-layout domination theorem removes the finite chart multiplier.
